'''Neer''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who crafted a [[Neer's Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] which was gifted anonymously to the [[Jedi Watchman]] of the [[Corbos system]]. After the malicious nature of the armor was discovered, the Gauntlet was confiscated and kept under guard within the [[Vault of Justice]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="NoP" />
